newsitem.title: UK: De La Rue shares drop again on results.
newsitem.headline: De La Rue shares drop again on results.

text.p: Shares in bank note printer and security products group De La Rue continued to fall on Wednesday after Tuesday's disappointing results and downbeat outlook.
In early trading the slipped another 20-1/2 pence -- nearly five percent --- to 401 pence.
On Tuesday, the stock dropped 63-1/2 pence -- 13 percent -- after 1996/97 annual profits of 120.2 million stg fell well short of analyst expectations.
"The overnight press wasn't very helpful and there wasn't anything to help them rally this morning. There's doesn't seem to be a lot of light at the end of the tunnel," said one trader.
Another suggested the falls were beginning to look overdone and the shares could attempt a rally from here.
